pages.text: $(bold)Small Ships$(): build a $(bold)dockyard$() beside water and it builds the ship from the stores you give it: cog, brig, galley, drakkar, caravel, dhow, galleon. Cannons go on deck; recruits captains can sail them and crew the guns.$(br2)Rivers and coasts are everywhere here. A cog moves more than ten wagons.
The dockyard: place it by the water. The ship's hull, sails and cannons come from what you load into it.

$(bold)Immersive Aircraft$(): hull, sail, engine and propeller make an airship, a gyrodyne you pedal, or a quadrocopter. Aluminum hulls and propellers come two to a craft.$(br2)$(bold)Ships are Tier 2$(): the Naga hold the dockyard and the airships. The $(bold)biplane$(), $(bold)warship$() and aircraft guns are $(bold)Cannons$() (Tier 3).
Cannon shot is lead or iron; a bronze cannon is cast from bronze blocks.
